## Core Statutory Services

### 1. Direct Taxation & Income Tax Returns (ITR)
- **Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing:** Individual salaried taxpayers (Form 16), professionals, freelancers, stock/F&O capital gains, Form 26AS & AIS reconciliation. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/income-tax-itr
- **TDS & TCS Returns:** Quarterly returns (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q), TDS certificates (Form 16/16A generation), and mismatch resolution. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/tds-tcs-services
- **NRI Taxation:** Foreign remittances, DTAA relief (Section 90/91), Form 15CA/CB certification, NRO/NRE account advisory. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/nri-taxation
- **Transfer Pricing:** International & specified domestic transactions, benchmarking analysis, Form 3CEB filing. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/transfer-pricing

### 2. Indirect Taxation & GST Compliance
- **GST Registration:** Regular, composition, and voluntary registration on the GST Common Portal with ARN tracking. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gst-registration
- **GST Monthly & Annual Returns:** GSTR-1 outward supplies, GSTR-3B summary, GSTR-9 annual return, GSTR-9C reconciliation, and Input Tax Credit (ITC) optimization. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gst-returns

### 3. Business Incorporation & Licensing
- **Private Limited Company Incorporation:** End-to-end MCA SPICe+ filing, name approval (RUN), DIN, PAN/TAN, digital signature, and certificate of incorporation. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/private-limited-company
- **Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration:** FiLLiP portal filing, LLP agreement drafting, and DPIN allotment. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/llp-registration
- **Partnership Firm & Proprietorship:** Partnership deed registration under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/firm-registration
- **Mumbai Gumasta / Shop & Establishment:** MCGM municipal commercial license in Mumbai. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gumasta-shop-establishment
- **Udyam MSME Registration:** Government of India MSME recognition for priority lending and subsidies. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/udyam-registration
- **FSSAI Food License:** Food business operator (FBO) registration and state license. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/fssai-registration
- **Import Export Code (IEC):** DGFT 10-digit code for international trade. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/import-export-code
- **Digital Signature Certificate (DSC):** Class 3 cryptographic USB signing tokens for MCA, ITR, and e-Tendering. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/digital-signature-certificate
- **Trademark Registration Assistance:** Brand name, wordmark, and logo filing with the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/trademark-registration

### 4. Accounting, Bookkeeping & Corporate Governance
- **Accounting & Financial Statement Finalization:** Tally, Zoho Books, ledger reconciliation, balance sheet finalization. Link: https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/accounting-services
